data.desc: IRADIMED CORPORATION is a leader in developing innovative Magnetic Resonance Imaging ('MRI') compatible medical devices. We design, manufacture, market, and distribute MRI-compatible medical devices, accessories, disposables, and related services.We are the only known provider of a non-magnetic intravenous ('IV') infusion pump system specifically designed to be safe for use during MRI procedures. We were the first to develop an infusion delivery system that largely eliminates many of the dangers and problems present during MRI procedures. Standard infusion pumps contain magnetic and electronic components that can create radio frequency interference and are dangerous to operate near the powerful magnet that drives an MRI system.
